Content words of a text

Source: R/content_words.R
content_words.Rd

Splits a text into sentences, runs a morphological analysis and picks the content words. A shortcut for as_sentences(), analyze_morphemes() and pick_content_words() in a row.

Usage

content_words(
  text,
  method = "mecab",
  bin_dir = "",
  iconv = "",
  pos = content_pos(),
  skip_pos_1 = skipped_pos_1(),
  stop_words = stop_words_ja(),
  ...
)

Arguments

text

A character vector of lines, or a data.frame of sentences as returned by as_sentences().

method

A string. Passed to moranajp::moranajp_all(): "mecab", "ginza", "sudachi_a", "sudachi_b" or "sudachi_c".

bin_dir

A string. Directory of the analyser.

iconv

A string. Encoding conversion of the analyser output, for example "CP932_UTF-8" when MeCab was built for Shift-JIS. Leave it empty for a UTF-8 dictionary.

pos

A character vector of parts of speech to keep.

skip_pos_1

A character vector of sub categories to drop.

stop_words

A character vector of words to drop.

...

Passed to moranajp::moranajp_all().

Value

A tibble as returned by pick_content_words(), or NULL when the analysis could not be run. Join it to the table of as_sentences() by sentence_id.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  # needs 'moranajp' and a local analyser such as MeCab
  content_words(sample_text(), bin_dir = "d:/pf/mecab/bin")
} # }
